data.narrative:
Sift Stack is a Series B AI & Software company founded by Karthik Gollapudi and Austin Spiegel. The company has raised $67M to date. The peer universe comprises 9 comparable firms across AI and software infrastructure, including 1 public company (Palantir) and 8 private firms. The most directly comparable peers at Series B stage are Scale AI ($29.0B), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B), and Black Forest Labs ($3.2B).

Two valuation methods apply to this analysis. Stage-progression, anchoring on $67M in total raised and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implies a valuation of $127M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $5.6B, with a range of $3.2B to $29.0B. The peer-median method reflects the heterogeneity within frontier AI—Scale AI commands a substantial premium while Black Forest Labs trades at the lower bound.

Triangulating these two methods produces a range of $108M to $6.4B, with a median of $2.9B. The wide dispersion reflects genuine uncertainty: stage-progression alone substantially underweights Sift Stack relative to frontier AI peer valuations, while peer-median relies on a small, volatile sample with extreme outliers. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, competitive positioning within the peer set, and market timing. A credible valuation likely sits in the $1.5B–$4.0B range pending disclosure of financial metrics.
